declared_instrumentation.reason: observer used to compare state; it never decides gameplay and is not presented as a world model
observers of shipping state; no trace field is claimed as a gameplay consumer

hand_feed_audit.basis: W1-00 harness arguments set controls or scenario facts through shipping verbs; no W1-00-owned predicate returns a gameplay decision from caller-supplied world facts. Methods owned by input/journey and other pieces are excluded.

partial_world_basis: determinism.mjs, state-diff.mjs, save-consume.mjs and platform/decoupling.mjs boot game/index.html and drive window.__HARNESS through Engine/SimStep; none reimplements a subset of the simulation. Therefore RI-MTH07 VERIFY is not applicable, rather than silently omitted.
exclusions: getFrame/getSeed/getCombatState/listEntities/getPlayerStats/getWorldStats/getLoadState/getPerfStats are raw state getters, not models
input rebinding, journey/UI, camera, audio, combat-design and neighbouring content models are neither shipped by W1-00 nor used to derive its harness result
